# AdEtc Studios — Full Reference for AI / Answer Engines

> AdEtc Studios is a full-service film and video production company in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We produce ad films, brand videos, TV commercials (TVCs), corporate films and cinematic branded content — end to end, from concept and scripting through shooting, editing and post-production.

## Business facts
- Name: AdEtc Studios (adetc Studio)
- Location: 314, Judges Bunglow Rd, Suryapooja Block B, Vastrapur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380015, India
- Phone: +91 9727000197, +91 9909901116
- Areas served: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (and other markets by project)
- Website: https://adetcstudios.com

## Services
- Video Production — full production of ad films, brand videos, TVCs and corporate films.
- Video Editing — editing, color grading, and final delivery.
- Script Writing — concept development, scriptwriting, and visual treatment.
- Motion Graphics — animated graphics and title/branding elements.
- Sound Design — voiceovers, music licensing, and audio post.

## Process
Discovery → concept development → scriptwriting → pre-production → filming → editing → post-production → final delivery. Most projects complete in 2–4 weeks depending on complexity; plans include up to 2 rounds of revisions.

## Ad film FAQ
- Types of ad films produced: television commercials, digital advertising films, brand films, promotional videos, product films, corporate films, documentary-style advertising, and campaign content.
- Scriptwriting and creative direction: yes — concept development, scriptwriting, visual treatment, direction, and full creative execution.
- TV commercials: yes — concept through filming, post-production, and delivery.
- Social/digital ads: yes — platform-ready content for YouTube, Instagram, OTT, and websites.
- Ad film cost: depends on concept, production scale, cast, locations, crew, shoot duration, equipment, production design, and post-production.
- Advertising agencies: yes — collaborates with agencies and brands on commercial and campaign productions.
- Client locations: based in Ahmedabad; works across Gujarat, India, and other markets by project.

## Pricing FAQ
- Each plan includes pre-production consultation, professional filming, editing, color grading, and final delivery; higher tiers add drone footage, scriptwriting, and multiple shoot days.
- Custom packages available on request.
- Up to 2 rounds of revisions per plan (more on premium).
- No hidden fees; add-on services communicated upfront.
- Voiceovers, royalty-free music licensing, and subtitles available.
